title: The Hackett Group® Announces Winners of the 2026 Hackett Innovation Awards
summary: Congratulations to the winners and finalists of the 2026 Hackett Innovation Awards! Each year we recognize organizations using AI to redesign workflows, accelerate performance, and deliver measurable business impact across the enterprise. The companies honored this year are moving beyond experimentation – reinventing how work gets done to drive sustained ROI at scale. “They are clear on the value they want to deliver, they rethink how work gets done across people and technology, and they invest purposefully in developing the skills and structures needed to make that change lasting and at scale.” - David Ketchin, managing director of Europe, The Hackett Group®.
